title: CLAUDE.md - Project Context
text: package EKIO’s single source truth brand color type. Downstream projects (ekio workspace, ekio-site) mirror — update first. Colors: defined inst/ekio-palettes.yaml (source truth), compiled R/sysdata.rda data-raw/palettes.R. Seven nine-step scales — blue, gray, stone, teal, green, orange, red — named 100–900, light dark; position == shade * 100. Primary blue.700 = #1E3A5F, ink gray.900 = #191A1C; accents orange.400 = #D3742A, gold.light = #D5AA48, teal.600 = #006261. Palettes defined token reference, literal hex. Gold accent, scale: three named tokens (light #D5AA48, mid #B88715, deep #966800) spine rungs 300/400/500, nine-step gold ramp turns brown dark end. Reached ekio_pal("gold")["mid"] .ekio("gold", "mid"). deep carries text-safe promise shade 500 carries scales. gold sequential palette exists. Token references: palette member literal hex, scale.shade (blue.700), group.name pointing named token group (gold.light, basic.pivot). palette written YAML mapping rather sequence becomes group. Scales win name collision. Generated, hand-picked: scales come one OKLCH spec data-raw/build-ramps.R — shared lightness spine (pinned blue.700 brand navy), shared chroma arc, hue path plus chroma budget per family. data-raw/palettes.R checks YAML hex spec refuses build drift. change color, edit spec, rerun Rscript data-raw/build-ramps.R, paste block YAML, rerun data-raw/palettes.R. Never hand-edit scale. spine buys: shade number means one visual weight every family, blue.500 orange.500 interchangeable. Shade 500 clears WCAG AA -white surface seven scales. properties asserted build time tests/testthat/test-palette-data.R. Categorical palettes vary shade purpose: equal lightness balances hues makes hard tell apart, series contrast sits rung. contrast (5) survives grayscale deuteranopia; full (8) separates hue past five categories . Surfaces: basic token group, scale — offwhite = #FEFEFE (theme_ekio() default background), white = #FFFFFF, pivot = #F5F3EF (diverging midpoint), black = #000000. gray.100 tint (#F2F3F5) reachable theme_ekio(background = "gray"). White, offwhite black hand-set hex package; pivot generated scales. basic internal .ekio() deliberately absent ekio_pal() list_ekio_palettes(); accent group, contrast, user-facing Type — web (ekio-site): Lora (serif display/headings), Lato (body), Fira Code (mono).

title: CLAUDE.md - Project Context
text: Unified palette access: palette types (accent, categorical, highlight, small-group, scientific, sequential, diverging) go ekio_pal(). Sequential/diverging palettes also usable continuous scales Smart aesthetic detection: Recipe functions use rlang::enquo() + internal .detect_aesthetic_type() distinguish missing args, static color strings, variable mappings — auto-selecting appropriate scales One recipe layer builder: recipes branch aesthetic type . .resolve_aes() detects type, applies recipe’s continuous policy settles palette; .recipe_layer() builds ggplot() + geom_*() call attaches scale. recipe supplies base aesthetics, geom geom arguments. Adding recipe means calling , copying branch tree Continuous policy per chart: .resolve_aes(continuous = ) "reject" histogram, line, bar area (continuous color/fill errors, pointing factor() binning) "warn" scatter. Change policy call site, never ad-hoc Modular themes: theme_ekio() uses ggplot2’s theme_sub_*() helpers paper argument theme_minimal() (requires ggplot2 >= 4.0.0) Namespace style: blanket @import ggplot2. Use ggplot2:: prefixes; @importFrom files many calls, like theme.R Conditional grids: theme_ekio() builds grid_x grid_y requested axes adds exist Independent ticks: theme_ekio(ticks = "x" | "y" | "xy" | "none") adds requested axis ticks lines independently major grids, allowing grid = "none" visible axes Color references: Never hardcode hex. Inside package use .ekio("blue", 700); user code use ekio_pal(). change color, edit spec data-raw/build-ramps.R, regenerate YAML scales: block, rerun data-raw/palettes.R

title: ekioplot 0.7.1
text: Removed blanket @import ggplot2 favor ggplot2:: prefixes, @importFrom retained theme.R, one file many calls. print.ekio_palette() picks swatch label colors ekio_text_on() instead private luminance approximation, removing third copy luminance math package. Dropped unused param_name argument .detect_aesthetic_type(), unused rlang::as_name import, dead assignments grid theme branches, stale globalVariables() declaration.

title: ekioplot 0.7.0
text: release makes inst/ekio-palettes.yaml single source truth EKIO brand color, aligns scale position shade number, moves gt table styling companion package. contains several breaking changes; see upgrading.

title: ekioplot 0.7.0
text: exported color vectors ekio_blue, ekio_gray, ekio_teal, ekio_orange, ekio_accent removed. brand color now reached ekio_pal(). ekio_accent byte-identical ekio_pal("full"); four scales now ekio_pal("blue") friends. Brand scales nine steps named "100" "900" instead ten named "50" "900". Position shade now aligned construction, ekio_pal("blue")[7] ekio_pal("blue")["700"] return color. Code indexed old ramps positionally need updating. "50" shades gone. near-duplicates "100" — luminance gap 1, 2, -1 gray, teal, orange median interior gap 24 — orange’s inverted ramp. theme_ekio()’s background now gray.100, change two luminance points. theme_ekio_map() removed. blanked axes moved legend; map needs (coord_sf(expand = FALSE), colorbar sizing) expressed theme object. gt_theme_ekio() moved companion package ekiotable. reads brand tokens package via ekio_pal(), tables charts stay sync without duplicating color definitions. gt longer dependency ekioplot. sequential diverging palettes, n now interpolates across whole ramp instead returning n lightest colors. ekio_pal("blue", n = 3) gives light/mid/dark triple. Categorical, small-group, scientific palettes still take first n. teal["50"] #F0FFF4 — identical green’s lightest tint, teal — removed. blue["800"] changes #1B3A4B #152A44; old value sat 3 luminance points blue.700 hue-shifted toward teal. purple, red, green, amber scales drop lightest tint gain "900", eight scales now identical structure. three diverging palettes change slightly. neutral pivot now guaranteed lightest color palette, visual center scale lands data’s zero: teal_orange previously peaked teal.100 (luminance 247) rather pivot (241), putting lightest point one slot center. cool arm now stops teal.200, shared warm pivot lighter. blue_red’s warm arm irregular (red.100, .300, .500, .600, .800 — 100-shade step among 200s), left red.500 red.600 19 luminance points apart neighbours 61 54, wasting class. now mirrors cool arm red.100, .300, .500, .700, .900. also narrows gap two extreme ends 39 luminance points 26, equally extreme values read equal weight. blue_orange keeps arms gains lighter pivot, removes 4-point step pivot orange.200.

title: ekioplot 0.7.0
text: ekio_contrast() computes WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio two colors. ekio_text_on() picks readable text color (black white) given background, labels colored fills. five recipe functions gain title, subtitle, caption arguments. previously way set plot text: title passed name fell ... geom, ggplot2 ignored warning — , ekio_barplot(), failed outright. Color defined inst/ekio-palettes.yaml compiled package data-raw/palettes.R. YAML ships package, downstream projects can read canonical tokens via system.file("ekio-palettes.yaml", package = "ekioplot"). Palettes defined scale.shade token reference rather literal hex, palette can longer drift sync scale built . build script fails token resolve, scale stops darkening monotonically, diverging palette’s pivot lightest color. test re-resolves YAML compares built data, editing one without rebuilding fails loudly.

title: ekioplot 0.7.0
text: ekio_pal(pal, n = length(pal)) routed colorRampPalette, returns unnamed vector, ekio_pal("blue", n = 9)["700"] gave NA ekio_pal("blue")["700"] worked. n matching palette length now -op.

title: ekioplot 0.5.1
text: list_ekio_palettes() gains verbose argument prints formatted summary selected palette type(s). ekio_pal() now returns object class ekio_palette, character vector custom print method automatically displays color swatch interactive sessions. replaces need separate show_ekio_palette() function. Use .character() strip class hex codes needed.

title: ekioplot 0.5.1
text: show_all_ekio_palettes() deprecated favor list_ekio_palettes(verbose = TRUE). still works warns per session, longer listed pkgdown reference index. show_ekio_palette() deprecated favor ekio_pal() (auto-displays swatch print). still works warns per session.

title: ekioplot 0.5.0
text: gt moved Imports Suggests. needed gt_theme_ekio(), now prompts install first use via rlang::check_installed(). drops 43 transitive dependencies (including V8, Rcpp, curl, bslib, htmlwidgets, reactable, knitr, rmarkdown) default install, leaving core plotting dependent ggplot2’s tree. Users style gt tables add gt dependencies. ekio_scatterplot() longer forces y = 0 baseline default (add_zero = FALSE). Scatter plots whose y values far zero distorted forced baseline. Pass add_zero = TRUE restore old behavior.

title: ekioplot 0.5.0
text: ekio_histogram() now handles transformed x expressions log(mpg); previously bin calculation errored anything bare column name.

title: ekioplot 0.5.0
text: Replaced dead Imazon reference URL ips_brasil dataset documentation.

title: ekioplot 0.4.0
text: Removed run_palette_lab() bundled Shiny app. Palette Lab now lives repository (https://github.com/viniciusoike/ekioplot-palette-lab) runs entirely browser https://viniciusoike.github.io/ekioplot-palette-lab/. drops 8 app-Suggests (bslib, colorspace, colourpicker, forcats, ggbump, patchwork, shiny, stringr), leaving ekioplot lean visualization package.

title: ekioplot 0.3.1
text: Rewrote README.md match current API (previous version referenced removed font helpers, theme style names, palette names longer exist).

title: ekioplot 0.3.1
text: Added R-CMD-check GitHub Actions workflow covering Windows, macOS, Linux (release, devel, oldrel). Removed stale repository artifacts scratch files.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Complete API overhaul. Palette system, themes, scales redesigned cleaner, consistent interface.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Unified palette access ekio_pal() — palette types (categorical, small-group, scientific, sequential, diverging) accessible single function. Added 8 sequential palettes (blue, teal, gray, orange, purple, red, green, amber) 3 diverging palettes (blue_orange, blue_red, teal_orange). Added curated small-group variants: duo_warm, duo_cool, trio_bold, trio_cool, quad_earth, quad_vivid. Added scientific palettes: okabe_ito, viridis, inferno, plasma. list_ekio_palettes() now validates type argument errors invalid types. ekio_orange now 10 shades (50-900), matching color scales.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: theme_ekio() rebuilt using ggplot2’s modular theme_sub_*() helpers (requires ggplot2 >= 3.5.0). Added theme_ekio_map() choropleth spatial visualizations.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Added continuous scale functions: scale_color_ekio_c() scale_fill_ekio_c() sequential diverging palettes. British spelling aliases (scale_colour_ekio_c(), scale_colour_ekio_d()) included.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Added high-level chart builders: ekio_histogram(), ekio_lineplot(), ekio_scatterplot(), ekio_barplot(), ekio_areaplot(). Smart aesthetic detection automatically distinguishes static colors variable mappings applies appropriate scales.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Added gt_theme_ekio() professional gt table styling EKIO branding. Fixed gt_theme_ekio() crashing tables without summary rows row groups.

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Added fuels dataset (global fuel consumption time series). Added brazil_agriculture, brazil_agriculture_states, brazil_gdp, brazil_population datasets. Added ips_brasil dataset (Social Progress Index Brazilian municipalities).

title: ekioplot 0.3.0
text: Removed dplyr dependency. Removed scales Imports (used directly). Removed dead code obsolete prototype files. Added Shiny palette explorer app (inst/shiny-app/). Added test coverage recipe functions gt theme.
